question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**enhance**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us about techniques that can be used to increase our concentration while studying.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate an action that fits the context of the passage.
 
• "**Enhance**" **(****बढ़ाना****)** fits well as it denotes an action that aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**discover**", "**commit**", "**convince**") do not fit the context of describing the impact of forest fires on forests and biodiversity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Discover (खोजना):** "Discover" means to find something.
 
• **Commit (प्रतिबद्ध करना):** "Commit" means to pledge or bind.
 
• **Convince (मनाना):** "Convince" means to persuade someone.
